# GitHub automation

See the [workflows README](workflows/README.md) for CI details. GitHub Actions checks the Python source, tests, saved conditional physics arithmetic, and public CSV integrity. Passing checks do not establish independent specimen-level experimental evidence.

This folder intentionally does **not** contain a file named `README.md`: GitHub gives `.github/README.md` priority over the project-root `README.md` when rendering the repository home page. The full research guide therefore remains at [the repository root](../README.md).
